subject: math
description: Apply coordinate rules for reflections and common rotations, then compare preimage and image coordinates.
learningObjectives: Identify a preimage and image on the coordinate plane
Apply reflection rules across the x-axis, y-axis, origin, and the line y = x
Apply common rotation rules about the origin for 90°, 180°, and 270° counterclockwise rotations
Compare coordinates before and after a transformation
Explain how signs and coordinate order change under reflections and rotations
prerequisites: Plotting ordered pairs on the Cartesian plane
